title: Fix misleading 'debitRedemption' test title in points_balance_dao_test.dart that never calls a method by that name

evidence.quote: test('debitRedemption returns false when balance is insufficient', () async {
// Use parentAdjust as a proxy since debitRedemption needs a redemptionId.

why: points_balance_dao.dart has no method named debitRedemption (grep-confirmed against lib/core/database/daos/points_balance_dao.dart: only getBalance/creditCompletion/parentAdjust/createRedemption/fulfilRedemption/declineRedemption exist). The test's own comment admits it substitutes parentAdjust 'as a proxy' — the body actually just re-verifies parentAdjust's clamp-at-zero behavior, already covered 3 tests earlier by 'parentAdjust deducts points (clamped at 0)'. A developer searching for debitRedemption/insufficient-balance coverage will find this test, believe it verifies that path, and waste time chasing a nonexistent API; the real insufficient-balance-on-redemption case is separately and correctly covered by the 'createRedemption returns null when balance is insufficient' test later in the same file.
recommendation: Rename the test to describe what it verifies ('parentAdjust clamps balance at 0 for a large negative delta') or delete it as a duplicate of the adjacent parentAdjust clamp test.
acceptance_criteria: Test renamed to match its actual body, or removed as a duplicate of the parentAdjust clamp test
No reference to a non-existent debitRedemption method remains in the file

corrections: Second evidence entry cites line 63 for the quote '// Use parentAdjust as a proxy since debitRedemption needs a redemptionId.' — that comment is actually at line 59; line 63 is 'await db.pointsBalanceDao.parentAdjust(1, -100);'. The underlying claim (no such method; duplicate test) is independently confirmed by fresh grep despite the line-number slip.
